From Random Words, grab 10 random words. On Kanji alive, list kanji with 8 strokes. On TED, find a talk (speaker yuval noah harari, topic politics, min 300s). From the Numbers API, get a historical fact about the year 1969. From Dr. Almotawa Quotes, share a random quote under 50 characters. From Uncovered Treasure, fetch the relevant item. From Indonesia School List, list schools in sub-district (kecamatan) ID 056010.
